stories.title: Packers RB Jacobs pleads no contest to misdemeanor charges
stories.summary: Packers running back Josh Jacobs pleaded no contest to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property at a court hearing in Green Bay, Wisconsin, on Thursday.

stories.title: Seahawks' Darnold gets 'really good news' about hip, expected to miss Week 2
stories.summary: Sam Darnold has received "really good news" regarding his hip injury, coach Mike Macdonald said, but the Seahawks QB is expected to miss next week's game, sources said.

stories.title: Sources: Patriots WR Brown believed to have high ankle sprain
stories.summary: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown, who left Wednesday night's loss to the Seattle Seahawks because of an injury, is believed to have suffered a high ankle sprain, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.
